# iphone-cli (`iph`) — Complete Reference for LLMs and AI Agents

> `HyunSeob/iphone-cli` (`iph`) is a 100% Rust, single-binary CLI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents read and operate any app on a real physical iPhone (iOS 27+) via the native accessibility tree — with no Xcode, no XCUITest, no WebDriverAgent, no code signing, and no app installed on the phone.

- Repository: https://github.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli
- Website: https://hyunseob.github.io/iphone-cli/
- Crate: https://crates.io/crates/iphone-cli
- Docs.rs: https://docs.rs/iphone-cli
- License: MIT

---

## Scope & Requirements

- **Host OS:** macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel universal binary), Windows 10/11 (x64)
- **Device:** Real physical iPhone running **iOS 27 or later**. Touch and text input use Apple's screen-sharing service (`com.apple.coredevice.displayservice`), introduced in iOS 27; input is not expected to work on iOS 26 or earlier.
- **Connection:** USB or the same LAN/Wi-Fi (host computer may use Ethernet; supports direct IP registration via `iph --udid <UDID> connect --ip <IP>` when mDNS/Bonjour discovery fails).
- **Out of Scope:** iOS Simulators, Android devices, Linux hosts, landscape orientation.

---

## Comparison with Other Real-iPhone Automation Approaches

- **vs. iPhone Mirroring + OCR tools** (`mirroir-mcp`, `iphone-mirror-mcp`, `phone-harness`):
  - `iphone-cli` reads the **native accessibility tree** (structured roles, labels, values, frames, identifiers) instead of relying on screenshots/Vision OCR.
  - Works on **Windows** as well as macOS, and works in the **EU** where macOS iPhone Mirroring is unavailable.
  - Supports multi-device selection by UDID and clipboard-backed Unicode/emoji pasting with clipboard restoration.
- **vs. Appium / WebDriverAgent / XCUITest**:
  - Requires **no Xcode**, **no Apple Developer signing**, **no WDA app installed on the iPhone**, and **no Node.js/Python/Appium runtime**.
- **vs. per-turn tool loops**:
  - Embeds a **QuickJS** engine inside the single binary so agents can execute loops, conditionals, `waitFor`, `readField`, and scrolling list collection (`readList`) in a single call (`iph script` / `iph run`).

---

## Installation

### macOS (prebuilt universal binary, no Rust or Xcode required)
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli/main/install.sh | sh
iph setup
```
Installs to `~/.local/bin/iph` (`IPH_INSTALL_DIR` and `IPH_VERSION` override defaults).

### Windows 10/11 (x64)
1. Install Apple's device service: Microsoft Store **Apple Devices** app or `winget install Apple.AppleMobileDeviceSupport`.
2. Download `iph-windows-x86_64.zip` from https://github.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli/releases and place `iph.exe` on `PATH`.
3. Plug in the iPhone, tap Trust, and run `iph setup`.

### Cargo (macOS & Windows, Rust 1.93+)
```sh
cargo install iphone-cli
```

### MCP & Agent Skill Registration
```sh
claude mcp add iph -- iph mcp          # Claude Code
codex mcp add iph -- iph mcp           # Codex
iph mcp --tools read,find,script       # expose a subset of tools

# Optional: link Agent Skill for shell-only or MCP usage
ln -s "$PWD/skills/iph" ~/.claude/skills/iph
ln -s "$PWD/skills/iph" ~/.codex/skills/iph
```

---

## Architecture

```
iph (CLI) ─┐
iph mcp  ──┼─ unix socket / named pipe ─ iph daemon ─ lockdown → CoreDeviceProxy → userspace TCP tunnel → RSD
           ┘                              ├ axAuditDaemon.remoteAXService   (screen elements)
                                          ├ displayservice + universalhid   (touch, keyboard)
                                          ├ pasteboardservice               (clipboard)
                                          ├ appservice                      (launch, app list)
                                          └ screencaptureservice            (PNG capture)
```

`iph daemon` starts automatically on the first request, holds the tunnel, accessibility subscription, and input session per phone, handles requests serially, and exits after 30 minutes of inactivity (configurable in `~/.config/iph/config.toml`).

---

## Core CLI Commands

Every command outputs JSON by default; pass `--human` for human-readable output.

- `iph devices` — list connected/cached phones, iOS version, transport, readiness
- `iph setup` / `iph doctor [--fix-wifi]` — onboarding checks and guided device readiness
- `iph connect --ip <IP>` — verify paired UDID and save direct IP address
- `iph read [--app] [--all] [--full] [--raw] [--max-age ms]` — read accessibility elements on screen
- `iph find <selector>` — find matching elements
- `iph tap <selector | x,y> [--long ms] [--double] [--no-wait]` — tap element center or coordinates
- `iph swipe <up|down|left|right | x1,y1,x2,y2> [--duration ms] [--drag]` — swipe or drag
- `iph pinch [in|out] [--scale F] [--rotate DEG] [--at selector | x,y] [--duration ms]` — two-finger zoom/rotate
- `iph scroll <up|down> [--until selector] [--max N]` — scroll one step or until selector appears
- `iph type <text> [--clear] [--submit]` — paste Unicode/emoji text into focused field, verify field value, restore clipboard
- `iph key <key>` — send keys (`return`, `esc`, `tab`, `cmd+a`, etc.)
- `iph button <home|lock|volume_up|volume_down>` — press hardware buttons
- `iph launch <bundle id | name> [--restart] [--env K=V]... [-- <args>...]` / `iph apps` — launch or list apps
- `iph screenshot [-o file]` — capture PNG screenshot
- `iph record <start|stop|status> [-o file.mp4] [--display N]` — record the screen to an MP4 (HEVC) while other commands run; record over USB; ends by itself after `record_max_secs` (default 1800)
- `iph batch <file | ->` — execute a JSON array of steps in one call
- `iph script <file | -> [--arg k=v]` — run QuickJS JavaScript automation in one call
- `iph run <name> [--arg k=v]` / `iph scripts` — run or list saved scripts (`~/.config/iph/scripts/<name>.js`)
- `iph mcp [--tools a,b]` — run stdio MCP server
- `iph syslog <start|read|status|stop> [--app bundle|name] [--process NAME] [--pid N] [--level L] [--after SEQ] [--grep RE] [--max N] [-o file]` — capture the phone's unified log into a memory buffer and read new entries with a cursor while other commands run
- `iph dnd <on|off|status>` — toggle Do Not Disturb to prevent notification banners from intercepting top-of-screen taps
- `iph diagnose [--wifi] [-- <cmd>]` — collect a diagnostic bundle for issue reporting
- `iph stop` — stop the resident daemon for the selected phone

---

## Selectors

- Plain string = exact label: `iph tap "General"` (rows like `"Wi-Fi, HomeNet"` also match `label="Wi-Fi"`)
- `label="exact"`, `label~="contains"`, `label/regex/`
- `role=button` (`application`, `button`, `switch`, `text_field`, `search_field`, `key`, `tab`, `header`, `text`, `image`, `link`, `adjustable`, `other`)
- `id=...`, `id~=...`, `id/regex/` (accessibility identifier or element id)
- `value="..."`, `value~=...`
- `within="<selector>"`, `index=N` (0-based)
- Multiple matches return `ambiguous_selector` with `candidates`; nothing is guessed.
- Scripts, MCP, and batch also accept selector objects: `{label, label_contains, label_regex, value, value_contains, value_regex, role, id, id_contains, id_regex, within, index}`.

---

## Safety Outcome Contract

| `outcome` | Meaning | Exit Code |
|---|---|---|
| `done` | Completed (`ok: false` only when `scroll --until` finishes without finding target) | `0` (`1` if `ok: false`) |
| `not_sent` | Nothing reached the phone; safe to retry | `1` |
| `unknown` | Input may have reached the phone; **do not resend**, read the screen first | `2` |

- `tap` waits for the screen to change and settle and returns the updated `elements[]`.
- `type --submit` withholds Return if any observation warning occurs (`value_unchanged`, `value_unreadable`, `value_change_unknown`, `value_empty`, `clear_not_observed`), returning `outcome: "unknown"`, `error.code: "type_not_verified"`, `submit_sent: false`.
- Inside `iph script`, any `unknown` outcome halts execution immediately even if caught by `try/catch`.

---

## Embedded QuickJS Script API

Available globals inside `iph script` (sandboxed: no filesystem, network, or process access):
- `read(opts)`, `find(selector, opts)`, `apps()`
- `tap(target | [targets...], {long_ms, double, timeout_ms, settle, no_wait})`
- `swipe(direction | {from, to}, {duration_ms, drag})`
- `pinch(direction | {scale, rotate, at}, {duration_ms})`
- `scroll(direction, {until, max})`
- `type(text, {clear, submit})`, `key(name)`, `button(name)`
- `launch(app, {restart, arguments, environment})`
- `syslog(action, opts)` — `start`, `read`, `status` or `stop`; scripts cannot write a file, and a capture outlives the script
- `record(action, {display})` — `start`, `stop` or `status`; scripts cannot choose the file; a recording the script leaves running ends with it (report under `recording`)
- `waitFor(selector, {timeout_ms})`
- `readField({selector, take, regex})`
- `readList({row, columns, key, group, stop_below, until, max_scrolls, limit})`
- `sleep(ms)`, `log(...)`, `output(k, v)`, `args`

---

## MCP Tools (`iph mcp`)

`iph_connect`, `iph_read`, `iph_find`, `iph_tap`, `iph_swipe`, `iph_pinch`, `iph_scroll`, `iph_type`, `iph_key`, `iph_button`, `iph_launch`, `iph_apps`, `iph_screenshot`, `iph_record`, `iph_batch`, `iph_script`, `iph_run`, `iph_scripts`, `iph_doctor`, `iph_dnd`, `iph_syslog`.
